text:
Oz Management LP Increases Holding in Nxp Semiconductors N V (NXPI) Posted by Marguerite Chambers 18 pm
Oz Management Lp increased its stake in Nxp Semiconductors N V (NXPI) by 18242.29% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Oz Management Lp bought 5.98M shares as the company’s stock declined 18.87% with the market. The hedge fund held 6.02 million shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $514.39 million, up from 32,800 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Oz Management Lp who had been investing in Nxp Semiconductors N V for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $20.01B market cap company. The stock decreased 3.74% or $2.63 during the last trading session, reaching $67.71. About 2.27 million shares traded. NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) has declined 33.99% since December 25, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 33.99% the S&P500.
Oz Management Lp, which manages about $56.28B and $18.08 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Sea Ltd by 1.48M shares to 2.79M shares, valued at $38.65 million in 2018Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Autoliv Inc (NYSE:ALV) by 87,768 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 237,603 shares, and cut its stake in Spdr S&P 500 Etf Tr (Call) (SPY).
